items.question: How long to see results?
items.answer: First impacts in 30-60 days. Solid authority, the kind that changes your negotiating position, is built in 6-12 months. Those seeking shortcuts won't find them here.

items.question: Do you guarantee results?
items.answer: We guarantee high-level strategy and full team commitment. Results depend on your willingness to show up. We only work with those willing to do their part.

items.question: What's the investment?
items.answer: Compatible with the level of results we deliver. After the selection conversation, we present a customized proposal. If you're looking for cheap, we're not the right fit.

items.question: Do you work with anyone?
items.answer: No. We have a rigorous selection process. We only accept professionals with real substance ready to assume authority position. Many are declined.

items.question: How does confidentiality work?
items.answer: Absolute and non-negotiable. Many of our most successful clients will never be publicly mentioned. Your secrets are safe.

items.question: Do you manage social media?
items.answer: Our focus is strategic positioning and media presence. We can orient your team to align with the overall strategy, but we don't execute operational work.
